precision_contract: x[M,K], w[N,K]: identical supplied FP16 or BF16 values, unchanged by every path; exact widening to FP32, FP32 accumulation, FP32 output [M,N]; errors vs FP64 on the same values. Vendor routes use CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F with FP32 output. TF32, FP16 accumulation and reduced-precision reductions disabled.
input_preparation: Test-data preparation, outside the operation: weights sampled by torch.randn directly in the target dtype; x sampled in FP32, scaled by 1/sqrt(K), then rounded once to the target dtype. The FP32-source rounding diagnostic is separate and labelled.
selection_rule: Lowest rotating-ring median among the threads x vector candidates on seed 901; frozen afterwards.
device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU

baselines.excluded: torch.mm with 16-bit output and output-cast chains are not equivalent; not timed

protocol: Each path cycles through a ring of >=max(80 MiB, 20x L2) of 16-bit weights (cuBLAS packed route: bitwise-identical transposed ring of the same size); the whole CUDA graph is timed and divided by the true call count. Random method order, >=31 rounds, no eviction kernel; GPU telemetry sampled.
acceptance: Noise-gated win: numerics pass, |A/A| <= 1%, bootstrap 95% lower bound of time saved vs best equivalent vendor > max(0, |A/A|). User target: same gates and lower bound > 10%. Only held-out validation cases count; tuning cases are in-sample.
gpu_unlock: No unlock effect is claimed. Actual module/boot state is recorded in environment.inventory.

inventory.board_hardware_validation: not established by allowlisting or compilation
inventory.power_snapshot_scope: sysfs read before nvidia-smi; does not establish idle behavior
inventory.scope: Read-only inventory. Does not establish hardware unlock state or hardware safety.
